title: A write, the shared volume, the replicas and a failover
claim: Writes go through the writer into one volume with six copies, and the Aurora Replicas read that same volume.
alt: A sequence with four participants: an application, the writer DB instance, the cluster volume in three Availability Zones, and an Aurora Replica. The application writes through the cluster endpoint, the writer stores the change in the volume, the replica reads the same volume for queries that come through the reader endpoint, and after a failure the replica becomes the writer.

messages.label: Write
messages.say: The application sends writes to the cluster endpoint, which connects to the current primary DB instance.

messages.label: Six copies
messages.say: Aurora synchronously replicates the data across Availability Zones to six storage nodes.

messages.label: Read
messages.say: Read-only connections use the reader endpoint, which spreads them among the Aurora Replicas.

messages.label: Same volume
messages.say: Aurora Replicas connect to the same storage volume as the writer, so no data is copied to them.

messages.label: Endpoint follows
messages.say: If the writer fails, Aurora automatically fails over to an Aurora Replica, and the cluster endpoint follows it.
